content:
## Home Loan Balance Transfer Kab Karna Chahiye?

Agar aapne 2-3 saal pehle kisi bank se home loan liya tha, toh ho sakta hai aapka interest rate aaj **8.75% se 9.50%** ho chuka ho, jabki naye borrowers ko **7.15%*** par loan mil raha hai.

---

### Balance Transfer Karne Ke Golden Rules:
1. **Interest Rate Difference kam se kam 0.50% to 0.75% hona chahiye:** Agar naya bank aapko 0.50%+ sasta de raha hai, toh balance transfer 100% profitable hai.
2. **Remaining Tenure 5 saal se zyada bacha ho:** Kyunki initial years mein interest component sabse zyada hota hai.
3. **No Foreclosure Charges:** RBI rules ke mutabiq individual floating rate home loans par ZERO foreclosure / prepayment penalty hoti hai.

---

### How to Reduce Home Loan EMI?
* **Annual 5% Prepayment:** Har saal sirf 1 additional EMI ya 5% principal prepay karne se 20 saal ka loan 12 saal mein khatam ho jata hai!
* **Tenure Re-structuring:** Balance transfer ke waqt tenure increase karke monthly EMI burden kam karein.
* **Top-Up Loan Facility:** Personal loan lene ke bajaye Home Loan Top-Up lein jo ki 8.5% ke aaspas milta hai.

content:
## How to Get Home Loan with Low CIBIL Score? Complete Solution Guide

Home loan apply karte waqt agar bank aapko bataye ki aapka **CIBIL score kam hai (550 - 680)** ya **-1 (no credit history)** hai, toh ghabraiye mat. Bhardwaj Financial Services (BFS) aapko step-by-step batata hai ki aap apna home loan kaise approve karwa sakte hain.

---

### 1. Ek Strong Co-Applicant Add Karein
Agar aapka CIBIL score kam hai, toh aap apne **Spouse (patni/pati)**, **Father**, ya **Son/Daughter** jinka CIBIL score 750+ ho, unhe Primary Co-Applicant bana sakte hain. Bank co-applicant ki creditworthiness aur income dono consider karke loan sanction kar deta hai.

---

### 2. Down Payment Badhayein (Lower LTV Ratio)
Aam taur par bank property cost ka 80%-85% loan dete hain. Agar CIBIL score kam hai, toh aap bank se 60%-70% funding maangiye (30%-40% khud invest karein). Kam loan exposure hone par bank ka risk minimize ho jata hai aur approval chances 80% badh jate hain.

---

### 3. Alternative Banking & Surrogate Programs
Bhardwaj Financial Services PNB, SBI ke alawa leading Housing Finance Companies (HFCs) aur NBFCs ke sath directly empaneled hai jo:
* GST Turnover Surrogate
* Banking Average Bank Balance (ABB) Surrogate
* Liquid Income Surrogate
par low CIBIL score profiles ko bhi 7.15%* to 8.50% ke competitive rates par fund karti hain.

---

### 4. CIBIL Score Ko 30-45 Dino Mein Kaise Boost Karein?
* **Credit Card Balance Clear Karein:** Apna Credit Utilization Ratio 30% se niche laayein.
* **Overdue Payments Settle Karein:** DPD (Days Past Due) ko zero karein.
* **CIBIL Dispute File Karein:** Agar report mein koi galat closed loan ya incorrect default show ho raha hai, toh use rectify karwayein.

## Home Loan Ke Liye Kitni Salary Chahiye? Complete Eligibility Guide

Agar aap Agra mein apna sapno ka ghar kharidne ya banwane ki planning kar rahe hain, toh sabse pehla sawal yahi aata hai: **"Home loan ke liye kitni salary chahiye?"**

Bhardwaj Financial Services (BFS) aapke liye lekar aaya hai sabse aasan aur complete guide jisse aap apna loan eligibility calculation khud samajh sakte hain.

---

### 1. Minimum Salary Requirement (Salaried Applicants)
* **Tier-2 Cities (Agra, Mathura, Firozabad):** Minimum Net Monthly Salary **₹15,000 se ₹25,000**.
* **Metro Cities (Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Bangalore):** Minimum Net Monthly Salary **₹25,000 se ₹35,000**.
* **Cash Salary Cases:** Agar aapki salary cash mein aati hai ya company salary slip nahi deti, toh bhi BFS alternative banking and employer verification programs ke through home loan sanction karata hai.

---

### 2. Kitni Salary Par Kitna Home Loan Mil Sakta Hai? (FOIR Rule)
Banks **FOIR (Fixed Obligation to Income Ratio)** ka formula use karte hain. Aam taur par bank aapki monthly income ka **50% se 60%** tak EMI allow karte hain:

| Net Monthly Salary | Max Monthly EMI (50% FOIR) | Approximate Loan Amount (30 Years @ 7.15%*) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **₹25,000** | ₹12,500 | **₹18.5 Lakhs** |
| **₹35,000** | ₹17,500 | **₹26 Lakhs** |
| **₹50,000** | ₹25,000 | **₹37 Lakhs** |
| **₹75,000** | ₹37,500 | **₹55 Lakhs** |
| **₹1,00,000** | ₹50,000 | **₹74 Lakhs** |
| **₹1,50,000** | ₹75,000 | **₹1.10 Crore** |

> **Pro-Tip:** Agar aapki salary kam hai, toh aap apne spouse, father, ya brother ko **Co-Applicant** banakar dono ki income club kar sakte hain, jisse aapka loan amount double ho jata hai!

---

### 3. Home Loan Documents Required (Document Checklist)
Home loan approval fast karne ke liye ye documents ready rakhein:
* **KYC Proofs:** PAN Card, Aadhaar Card, Passport Size Photos.
* **Income Proof (Salaried):** Last 3 months Salary Slips, 6 months Bank Account Statement, Form 16 / ITR.
* **Income Proof (Self-Employed):** Last 2 years ITR with Computation Sheet, 12 months Bank Statement, GST Registration / Udyam Certificate.
* **Property Documents:** Registry Chain, Approved Map / Sanction Plan, Agreement to Sale (ATS).

---

### 4. CIBIL Score Kam Ho To Loan Milega Kya?
* **750+ CIBIL Score:** Best rates starting from 7.15%* p.a. with fast 5-day sanction.
* **650 - 750 CIBIL Score:** Loan sanction ho sakta hai with slightly adjusted ROI or additional co-applicant guarantee.
* **-1 CIBIL (No History):** Fresh salaried individuals ke liye special banking surrogate programs available hain.

Bhardwaj Financial Services (Sanjay Place, Agra) aapko free CIBIL score improvement advice aur bank matching provide karta hai.
